title: Mouse Interactions
description: Double-click, right-click, click and hold, and click with different mouse buttons and modifier keys.

double-click.title: Double-click
double-click.instructions: Only a double-click counts here: single clicks are ignored.
double-click.label: Double-click me

context-menu.title: Context menu
context-menu.instructions: Right-click the note to open its menu. The browser's own menu does not appear.

hold.title: Click and hold
hold.instructions: Press and hold the button for {{seconds}} second to confirm. Letting go or moving off it sooner does not count.
hold.label: Hold to confirm

buttons.title: Mouse buttons and modifiers
buttons.instructions: Click the box with any mouse button, holding Shift, Control, Alt or Meta if you like.
buttons.label: Click me with any button

result.title: Last interaction
result.hold-confirmed: Held the button long enough to confirm
result.hold-early: Let go of the hold button too early
